title: "Top 5 AI‑Intense Counties & Predictor Histograms"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tigris)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# 1a. Compute each county’s average AI share over 2018–2023
df_top5 <- read_csv("data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2018:2023) %>%
  mutate(ai_share = ai / nads) %>%
  group_by(COUNTY_FIPS) %>%
  summarize(avg_ai_share = mean(ai_share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_ai_share)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(COUNTY_FIPS = str_pad(as.character(COUNTY_FIPS), 5, pad = "0"))

# 1b. Get county names
counties_sf <- suppressMessages(counties(cb = TRUE, year = 2020, class = "sf"))
top5 <- df_top5 %>%
  left_join(
    transmute(counties_sf, COUNTY_FIPS = GEOID, County = paste0(NAME, ", ", STATEFP)),
    by = "COUNTY_FIPS"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = row_number(),
    `Avg AI Share (%)` = scales::percent(avg_ai_share, accuracy = 0.01)
  ) %>%
  select(Rank, County, `Avg AI Share (%)`)

# 1c. Render nicely
top5 %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Top 5 U.S. Counties by Average AI Job Share (2018–2023)",
    align = c("l", "c", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

```

```{r}
raw23 <- read_csv("data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>%
  transmute(
    share_bac,                                        # % bachelor’s
    tightness = nads / Unemployed,                    # labor tightness
    pat_intensity = n_inventors / Employed,           # patents/employee
    stemshare = (ustemdeg + mstemdeg) / (udeg + mdeg),# STEM‐degree share
    manuf_intensity = manuf_emp / emp                 # manufacturing intensity
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

data_z <- raw23 %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)), .names = "z_{col}"))

```

```{r}
ggplot(data_z, aes(z_share_bac)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25, fill = "#2c7fb8", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Bachelor’s‑Degree Share (z‑score)",
    x = "z‑score", y = "Number of Counties"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
ggplot(data_z, aes(z_tightness)) +
```
